answer: Bind each agent to one machine via its copper-bus hardware fingerprint: the TPM signs each epoch challenge with the device's copper-trace resistance pattern, unfakeable by any cloud instance. One, register the fingerprint at onboarding. Two, re-prove the same hardware each epoch with a fresh nonce. Three, a quarterly summit of established agents cross-checks them; two identities sharing one chip freeze together. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 10,000 machines at $400 each, $4,000,000, plus 60 audit days. A sybil farm here is a nebula whose stars share one light: lovely afar, bare up close.
